pages.text: Tier 4 bosses are the hardest content in the pack. Full Tier 4 gear is strongly recommended. Deep Aether, End, and Ultimate Bosses all require preparation.

$(bold)Ender Dragon$(/bold) — Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Waking Lichblade$(/l) (25% — highest in the pack), Dragon Heart, Dragon Scale. Scales progressively.$(br2)$(bold)Ultimate Bosses: Sorcerer$(/bold) — Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Mjolnir$(/l) (20%), tokens.$(br2)$(bold)Ultimate Bosses: Storm$(/bold) — Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Storm's Edge$(/l) (20%), tokens.

$(bold)Deep Aether Boss$(/bold) — EOTS Controller. Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Flamewind$(/l) (18%), T4 boss materials.$(br2)$(bold)The Abyss Bosses$(/bold) — 6 bosses across the Abyss: The Other Side dimension. $(warn)Note: 6 Abyss weapon IDs are pending in-game registry verification.
